dimension_1_eos_sound_speed.cause: GenCase hswl auto='true' sets hswl = (Nz - 1)*dp = H - dp instead of continuum depth H.
dimension_1_eos_sound_speed.untested_hypothesis: Locking hswl=0.4m (B=224228.6 Pa) will close the 12% WG1/WG2 gap.
dimension_1_eos_sound_speed.theoretical_falsification: Mach number M ~ 0.05. Compressibility celerity correction is O(M^2) ~ 0.0026. A 1.98% sound speed change alters relative wave elevation by <= 0.08% (< 0.3 mm), proving EOS parity cannot bridge 12%.

dimension_2_pressure_density_init.proven_differences: rhopgradient=3 applies hydrostatic density rho(z) = rho0*(1 + P(z)/B)^(1/gamma). Because zmax(dp) and B(dp) vary with dp, the t=0 density field is resolution-dependent.
dimension_2_pressure_density_init.untested_hypothesis: Initial density variance causes transient elevation divergence.
dimension_2_pressure_density_init.theoretical_falsification: Initial offsets are measured at <= 15 micrometres, proving initial hydrostatic state is in mechanical equilibrium at t=0.

dimension_3_smoothing_boundary_support.proven_differences: coefh=1.5 yields 3D h = 1.5*sqrt(3)*dp = 2.598076*dp. Kernel support 2h scales from 0.2598m (coarse) to 0.0520m (fine). DBC repulsive boundary interaction layer changes by 5x.
dimension_3_smoothing_boundary_support.untested_hypothesis: Boundary layer thickness variation causes 12% phase/amplitude shift.
dimension_3_smoothing_boundary_support.assessment: Physical candidate: wall dissipation and effective slip vary with h.

dimension_4_moving_paddle_nodes.proven_differences: Piston motion file piston_f91973457a049db5_regular_piston.dat is bitwise identical across all cases (sha256 8cb7dab074...). Discrete wall nodes scale from 3,128 (coarse) to 15,947 (medium) to 169,817 (fine).
dimension_4_moving_paddle_nodes.untested_hypothesis: Coarse moving node discretization generates weaker or phase-shifted wave packets.
dimension_4_moving_paddle_nodes.assessment: Piston stroke is 0.0078m (7.8mm). At dp=0.025m, the stroke is smaller than 1 particle spacing (0.31 dp). At dp=0.010m, the stroke is 0.78 dp.

dimension_5_temporal_controls.proven_differences: All runs completed with 0 DTsMin adjustments (0 clamps). However, spatial ladder refinement coupled space and time (dt ~ h ~ dp). Median dt ranged from 6.4e-4s (coarse) to 7.4e-5s (fine). No independent CFL halfstep study at fixed dp exists.
dimension_5_temporal_controls.untested_hypothesis: Symplectic integration error contributes significantly to 12% gap.
dimension_5_temporal_controls.theoretical_falsification: Symplectic local truncation error is O(dt^2) ~ 1e-8, negligible compared to spatial discretization error O(h^2) ~ 6e-4.

governing_physical_root_cause.identification: Insufficient small dp (spatial under-resolution of wave profile).
governing_physical_root_cause.rationale: Generated wave height H_wave is ~ 0.04m. At dp=0.025m, H_wave/dp = 1.6 particles. At dp=0.010m, H_wave/dp = 4.0 particles. SPH wave dynamics requires H_wave/dp >= 10 particles to resolve free surface curvature without excessive numerical dissipation from artificial viscosity.

falsifiable_next_step.rationale: Test and falsify the numerical recipe hypothesis (EOS parity) under credible GPU/storage budgets before considering sub-grid resolution shifts.
